# Announce options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

60 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `World:Announce`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AntiCheat:AllowNamesInWorldMessage` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Let the world message carry character names when the announcing code supplies a text for it. Off by default. |
| `AntiCheat:DedupSeconds` | `int` | `30` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | An announcement identical to one delivered this many seconds ago is suppressed. 0 disables the window. |
| `AntiCheat:GmNotify` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Send the announcement to every online account above Player (an on-screen notification and a chat line). Staff only. |
| `AntiCheat:IncludeDetails` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Add the staff-only detail (who, how long, counts, hashes) to the staff chat line. Players never see it. |
| `AntiCheat:MinimumSeverity` | `AnnounceSeverity` | `Info` | Info \| Warning \| Error \| Critical | World | start | Announcements below this severity are logged and counted but not delivered. Values: `Info`, `Warning`, `Error`, `Critical`. |
| `AntiCheat:RateBurst` | `int` | `10` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Rate limit: how many announcements of this category may go out back to back before the limit applies. 0 disables the limit. |
| `AntiCheat:RatePerMinute` | `int` | `20` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Rate limit: announcements of this category refilled per minute once the burst is used. Suppressed ones are counted and reported on the next delivered announcement. |
| `AntiCheat:WorldMessage` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Send a short system chat line to every online player. Never carries account names; never carries character names unless `AllowNamesInWorldMessage`. |
